title: Blue water, wild encounters
alt: Mobula rays and a diver in the blue water of the Azores
intro: An open-ocean journey shaped by the life moving through the Azores.
description: The archived Azores itinerary centered on mako and blue sharks, mobula rays, and dolphins around Pico. The experience asks for a willingness to follow the day's conditions and remain curious about what appears.
